ev.q: 29 meningococcal disease cases have been reported among persons with HIV in 2022, accounting for 9.8% of all cases
i.e., 14 cases compared with four to eight cases per year during 2017–2021

This report describes an increase in meningococcal disease among persons with HIV in the United States in 2022.
